comments.text:
I am an Even plus member but still i had to visit the hospital multiple for xyz document whichever was told by the even team and they don't tell in one go. Day by day they required a new document.

Also, there are some hidden information such as in the policy document it;s mentioned what is not covered but those are not fully details, I stuck in such situation where the even team denies when i asked where it is mentioned then they replied that there are lot of medical things which can't be covered in this document.

The only best thing they have is the UPI Scanner which help us to visit external doctor in case of emergency and we don't have to pay any consultation amount from our own pocket and also they have online unlimited consultations along with arranging some tests at home.

Rest the customer service is not that good, don't expect quick response from the team and they are not capable for handling customer queries and also customer service is poor whenever we are in case of emergency.

This is my experience, I believe other people have their own opinion but i had mentioned all this because of frustration, irritation and etc which i got at the time when i required help from the even team. (I have lots of messages and emails with me)

comments.text:
Dont fall for these frauds, let me narrate a personal incident:

I had a fall and was under their treatment, for 2 months. The clinical advise given to me was to get operated on my knee since it was a ligament tear. After getting written confirmation from their teams multiple times that this treatment was covered. i got admitted to hospital.

After reaching hospital, 2 hours before my surgery i get a call from some customer support who sounded like a kid out of college working from home, that my surgery had a 1 year waiting period!! yes can you imagine.

after reaching out to them multiple times including their founder, i got no proper response, however just a clarification and a message saying please renew your membership after one month for us to serve you better!!!

in times of crisis, they will leave you to die, its a scam. On getting professional legal counsel, their policy is a group health policy which they have taken under their name and reselling that to make us FOOLS.

Can you believe it!!!
